sources.title: Mistral Small 3 release announcement
sources.evidence: Dated January 30, 2025; introduces Mistral Small 3 as a 24B model, releases pretrained and instruction-tuned weights under Apache 2.0, and names low-latency function calling. Says the release was not trained with RL or synthetic data.

sources.title: Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501 model card
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies this checkpoint as the instruction-fine-tuned Mistral Small 3 (2501), developed by Mistral AI; states 24B parameters, Apache 2.0, a 32k context, native function calling and JSON output. Includes a working function-calling example. Its general reasoning-capability language does not specify a dedicated native reasoning mode.

sources.title: Mistral Small 2501 Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: MistralForCausalLM, model_type mistral, 40 layers, hidden size 5120, intermediate size 32768, 32 attention heads, 8 KV heads, max_position_embeddings 32768, no sliding window, untied embeddings and bfloat16 weights.

sources.title: Mistral Small 2501 native parameters
sources.evidence: Native configuration explicitly sets max_seq_len=32768 and max_position_embeddings=32768, independently resolving the model card and documentation shorthand 32k. It describes 40 transformer layers and standard attention/MLP dimensions.

sources.title: Mistral Small 2501 checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Retrieved directly over HTTPS. Contains 363 indexed tensors: embeddings, lm_head, final norm and 40 sets of attention projections, dense gated MLP projections, and layer norms. This complete tensor inventory and the architecture configuration support a dense decoder-only Transformer; no MoE expert/router tensors are present. No weight shards were downloaded.

sources.title: Pinned official Mistral Small 3.0 v25.01 documentation data
sources.evidence: The Instruct Weights entry links this exact Hugging Face checkpoint and explicitly lists parameters=24 and active=24. Also gives Apache 2.0, January 30, 2025 release, API ID mistral-small-2501, text input and text output, 32k context, and function calling. Reasoning is absent from a features enumeration, which is not treated as an explicit false claim.

sources.title: Pinned official weights-table unit labels
sources.evidence: The official renderer labels the separate parameters and active fields as Parameters (B) and Active (B), respectively, establishing the units of the exact model data in s6.

sources.title: Mistral Small 3.0 v25.01 model documentation
sources.evidence: Current legacy model page identifies the January 30, 2025 Mistral Small 3.0 release, API ID mistral-small-2501, Apache 2.0, 24B size, 32k context and function calling. It marks the API model retired; this audit does not infer current endpoint availability.

name.note: Original launch name; the current docs call the same January 2025 release Mistral Small 3.0. This record is the Instruct checkpoint, not the base checkpoint or later Small 3.1, 3.2 or 4.

developer.note: Model card explicitly credits the Mistral AI Team; preserve the catalog display name.

family.note: The official product and checkpoint names identify the Mistral Small family; this is the catalog-normalized family key.

release_date.note: Original dated announcement explicitly says the pretrained and instruction-tuned checkpoints are being released and available that day.

open_weights.note: The official release publishes downloadable instruction-tuned weights and the official checkpoint contains indexed weight shards.

license.note: Explicitly stated for this release and the exact Instruct Weights entry.

parameters_b.note: Nominal total parameter count in billions, explicitly published by Mistral. This is the disclosed 24B label, not an exact tensor-element count.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal active parameter count explicitly reported in the separate Active (B) field for this exact Instruct checkpoint. It is not inferred merely by equating dense-model active and total counts.

architecture.note: The published MistralForCausalLM configuration and complete checkpoint index define a dense decoder-only Transformer with standard attention and gated MLPs in each of 40 layers; no expert-routing structure.

context_window.note: Preserve the supported exact token count: the native params.json max_seq_len=32768 resolves 32k shorthand. This does not rely only on positional capacity and does not transfer the 128k context of Small 3.1.

modalities.note: Official data for this exact release explicitly lists text input and text output; later Small 3.1 vision support is not transferred.

reasoning.note: The card advertises general reasoning ability, while the launch describes an instruction model without RL and a base for future reasoning models. Neither explicitly establishes or excludes a dedicated native reasoning mode for 2501. Omission from a capabilities enumeration is not sufficient to verify false; clear the baseline assertion.

tool_call.note: The exact model card explicitly states native function calling and provides a tool-calling example; correct baseline false.

description.value: Instruction-tuned 24B text model with a 32,768-token context window, native function calling, and Apache-2.0 weights.
description.note: Replace generic use-case wording with directly supported checkpoint characteristics, without benchmark or efficiency superlatives.

patch.description: Instruction-tuned 24B text model with a 32,768-token context window, native function calling, and Apache-2.0 weights.
patch.notes: January 2025 Mistral Small 3 Instruct checkpoint. Total and active parameter counts are nominal disclosures of 24B each in separate official documentation fields. Native max_seq_len is 32768. Native dedicated reasoning support remains unverified; general reasoning skill is not treated as an explicit reasoning-mode flag.

sources.label: Pinned official Mistral Small 3.0 v25.01 documentation data

summary: Confirmed the January 30, 2025 text-only Instruct release and 32,768-token native context. Add Apache-2.0, nominal 24B total and separately disclosed 24B active parameters, and dense architecture; correct native tool calling to true. Replace the generic description. Clear the unsupported native reasoning=false assertion to null; a dedicated native reasoning classification remains unverified. No specifications are transferred from Small 3.1, 3.2 or 4.
